details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. Revenue growth is explained through sales mix shifts (S12-S14). Profitability declines are logically connected to increased distribution/administrative expenses (S7) and reduced net finance income (S10). The relationships between revenue, profit margins, and earnings are consistently presented. All figures are reported without conflicting implications, and the summary forms a clear narrative from revenue performance through to cash flow and balance sheet positions. No material logical gaps, contradictions, or organizational issues are present.
